description: Register a SQLUrlResource (connect via a single SQLAlchemy connection URL, dialect-agnostic) for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

connection_url.label: Connection Url
connection_url.description: Full SQLAlchemy connection URL (literal), e.g. 'postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/dbname'. Set this OR connection_url_env_var.

connection_url_env_var.label: Connection Url Env Var
connection_url_env_var.description: Env var holding the full connection URL. Set this OR connection_url.

name: SQL URL Resource
